xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3933

plan.title: bug(lifecycle): xbrief:activate / vbrief:activate manufacture a version-less vBRIEFInfo on a v0.8 brief, which then fails validation

narratives.Description: bug(lifecycle): xbrief:activate / vbrief:activate manufacture a version-less vBRIEFInfo on a v0.8 brief, which then fails validation
narratives.Overview: packages/core/src/vbrief-activate/activate.ts creates an envelope when one is absent, then stamps it. On a canonical v0.8 brief payload.vBRIEFInfo is correctly undefined because the envelope is xBRIEFInfo, so the branch manufactures a version-less vBRIEFInfo beside a valid xBRIEFInfo. VALID_INFO_ROOT_KEYS iterates vBRIEFInfo before xBRIEFInfo, so the manufactured block wins resolution and validation fails. Affected surfaces are xbrief:activate and vbrief:activate only; canonical scope:activate routes through scope/transition.ts runTransition and is not affected. A second create-on-absent path exists at packages/core/src/intake/reconcile-issues.ts. Envelope resolution is split three ways: validateVbriefSchema.resolveInfoBlock is exported, the stampEnvelopeUpdated helper in transition is private, and reconcile is bespoke.
narratives.Constraint: Do not change canonical scope:activate behaviour. Do not sweep every lifecycle mutator. Do not retire or delete the vbrief-activate surface. Replacing the activate.test.ts create-on-absent expectation is authorized by acceptance criterion 5 under #3156 as repair of a false invariant; no other assertion may be changed to go green.
narratives.Risk: Low. The change removes a create-on-absent branch and adds a named refusal. The remedy choice between delegating the companion aliases through runTransition and a local parity patch is recorded with evidence.
narratives.Test: Vitest at the module level in packages/core/src/vbrief-activate/activate.test.ts covers v0.8-only stamped with no legacy key added, v0.6-only stamped in place, and neither-envelope refused before the move. Dispatcher-level tests in packages/cli/src/lifecycle-cli cover xbrief:activate and vbrief:activate end to end plus schema validation of the activated artifact. packages/core/src/scope/transition.test.ts pins that canonical scope:activate envelope behaviour is unchanged. The intake reconcile path gets its own regression test.
narratives.Outcome: Activating a v0.8 brief through either companion alias leaves exactly one envelope and passes schema validation; a legacy v0.6 brief is stamped in place; an envelope-less brief is refused by name before the file moves; the second create-on-absent path in reconcile is brought under the same policy; canonical scope:activate is unchanged and pinned.
narratives.Decisions: - xbrief/decisions/2026-08-30-take-the-recorded-fallback-for-3933-a-local-envelope-parity-patc.decision.json — Take the recorded fallback for #3933: a local envelope-parity patch in vbrief-activate plus a shared lifecycle envelope policy, not delegation of the companion aliases through runTransition

items.title: Activating a v0.8 brief that carries only xBRIEFInfo through xbrief:activate leaves exactly one envelope, and schema validation passes on the result.
Activating a legacy v0.6 brief that carries only vBRIEFInfo still stamps updated in place.
A brief carrying neither envelope is refused by name before the file is moved.

The activate.test.ts create-on-absent expectation is replaced by three explicit assertions and the #1782 parity claim is updated to state that the create-on-absent behaviour of the Python oracle is not preserved.
The create-on-absent path in intake/reconcile-issues.ts is brought under the same policy, or an explicit recorded reason is given for why it differs.
Canonical scope:activate behaviour is unchanged, pinned by a test.
The remedy choice (delegate versus local parity patch) is recorded with the evidence that selected it.
